allowed_if_core_go: The tested Transformer benefits from prior exposure to evaluation semantics.
For a passing task, the original protocol exceeds the strict protocol by the reported paired delta.
forbidden_without_additional_evidence: The original paper model memorizes evaluation functions.
All model families rely on memorization.
Every benchmark with semantic overlap has inflated accuracy.

conditional_expansion.ranking_test: Run the released LSTM on Sparse Disjunction only if the Transformer Sparse Disjunction result passes core_go. A ranking-change claim requires the model ordering to reverse between protocols; otherwise the claim is forbidden.
conditional_expansion.transformer_seeds_3_and_4: Run only for tasks passing core_go after the frozen three-seed analysis.

evaluation.unit_of_analysis: evaluation episode, clustered by semantic ID

gate.core_go: At least one preregistered task has mean original-minus-strict tail-accuracy >= 2.0 pp and all three seed deltas are positive.
gate.no_go: No task passes core_go. Report the null/negative result and do not claim observed neural reliance on semantic exposure.
gate.reporting_rule: Report all tasks and seeds regardless of gate outcome.
gate.strong_pattern: Sparse Disjunction is >= 5.0 pp, Conjunction absolute delta is <= 2.0 pp, and task effects increase from low to high expected exposure.

primary.definition: mean sign accuracy over zero-indexed positions 20 through 39
primary.name: tail_accuracy

metrics.uncertainty: Report each model-seed paired delta and a paired cluster bootstrap over semantic IDs within each seed. Do not treat positions as independent observations.

scope: Controlled behavioral test of semantic exposure under the released Boolean ICL generators; not a reproduction of unreleased paper checkpoints.

conjunction_d28.proof_status: injective for the released task family; conjunction and majority validated by exhaustive truth tables at d=6

majority_d28.proof_status: injective for the released task family; conjunction and majority validated by exhaustive truth tables at d=6
majority_d28.semantic_id: bit mask of the active-variable subset

sparse_disjunction_d50_k4_positive.proof_status: injective for the released task family; conjunction and majority validated by exhaustive truth tables at d=6
sparse_disjunction_d50_k4_positive.semantic_id: bit mask of the four active positive literals

split.evaluation_sampling: i.i.d. with replacement from the released distribution
split.paired_slot_rule: Original and strict use the same primary function at every training slot. Strict replaces only slots whose primary semantic ID is excluded, using a separately seeded conditional stream.
split.strict_exclusion: Every unique evaluation semantic ID is excluded from every strict training-function draw.

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final checkpoint; no validation selection
training.loss: released sigmoid plus binary cross entropy
